problems.text: A galvanic cell joins a Zn electrode in 1 M Zn²⁺ to a Cu electrode in 1 M Cu²⁺ through a salt bridge. Which metal is the anode, which way do electrons flow in the wire, and toward which electrode do anions move in the salt bridge? Find E°cell from Appendix L.
problems.constants: Appendix L (OpenStax); F = 96,485 C/mol; 0.0592 V at 25 °C; molar masses from the OpenStax periodic table. Amounts: SCENARIO_CLAUDE.
